regular_medication: Usual ongoing medication, including uncertainty about today's dose in the same context; not administration during this encounter.
administered_treatment: Treatment explicitly actually given during this encounter. Patient-reported taking alone does not establish encounter administration.
historical_medication: A past medication course, not established as current regular use or current encounter administration.
planned_or_prescribed_treatment: Proposed, planned or prescribed treatment; not evidence it was given.
explicitly_not_administered: Explicit statement treatment was not given, including no treatment/no other treatment. Never treat this as administration.
allergy_statement: Allergy wording, reaction, patient attribution, explicit absence, uncertainty or not asked. Preserve the entire statement.
mixed_or_unclear: More than one relevant role in the same unit, or a medication mention whose role is unclear. Requires manual review, never exclusion or successful extraction.
other: No relevant medication/allergy fact. Do not discard relevant negatives or uncertainty as other.
